topic: The Magic of Dandelin Spheres: Unveiling Conic Sections
target_audience: High school geometry or early undergraduate students

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Plane-Cone Intersection
lecture_lines: A plane slices a cone, creating distinct shapes.
Tilting the plane changes the conic section's form.
Circle, ellipse, parabola, or hyperbola emerge clearly.
animations: Create a 3D wireframe cone using, centered. Color: #FFFFFF.
Rotate a flat plane (#FF0000) through the at varying angles.
Show the cross-sections of: Circle (#00FF00), Ellipse (#0000FF), Parabola (#FFFF00), Hyperbola (#FF00FF).

sections.title: Introducing the Dandelin Spheres
lecture_lines: Dandelin spheres fit perfectly inside a hollow cone.
Each sphere touches the cone's wall perfectly.
A plane cuts both the cone and sphere.
animations: Display a cone (#FFFFFF) and an intersecting plane (#FF0000).
Insert a sphere (#FFCC00) tangent to the cone surface.
Highlight the contact point between sphere and plane as a 'focus' (#FFFFFF, scale 0.4).

sections.title: The Geometric Proof Strategy
lecture_lines: Points of tangency mark the conic section's focus.
Equal tangent lengths define the ellipse's sum.
This geometric bridge reveals the constant distance property.
animations: Place two spheres (#FFCC00) inside the cone, tangent to the plane.
Draw two lines from a point on the intersection curve to the two focal points.
Show that the sum of these distances remains constant as the point moves along the curve.

sections.title: Visualizing Different Conics
lecture_lines: Adjusting plane angles shifts these magic spheres.
One sphere supports an ellipse or parabola.
Two spheres define the hyperbola's unique geometry.
animations: Start with one sphere for an ellipse intersection.
Shift the plane angle to show a parabola and adjust to one sphere.
Shift the plane angle to a hyperbola and insert a second sphere.

sections.title: Conclusion and Real-World Application
lecture_lines: Dandelin spheres unite 3D forms and 2D curves.
Orbits and telescope designs rely on this geometry.
Geometric insight reveals the beauty of conic sections.
